full_details: Before church the loaf was shrunk on the pan, and the price was still a penny. At St Helen's the floor was rushes and the church was full. Master Thwaite preached the gift of tongues and set the glass down after one turning. He then read, by order and after Friday, a portion of the Homily against Disobedience and Wilful Rebellion. The Mayor's pew had two more servants at the door than at Easter. In the north aisle a dark head in a small ruff did not turn, until the second lesson, once, toward the south, and away. You lost the place in the psalm. Nothing was said. She was gone by the north porch. At the Fields' the shop was shut. There was lamb and the first peas. Richard wanted the comedy for the press. You said the copy was Garnish's and the company's. He named forty pence. Jacqueline said you were both right. You told them the streets by Bishopsgate were quiet enough, and you told them nothing of Friday. You did not bring the Holinshed. After dark you made one small cross, with no name and no account.
one_sentence: You heard one glass at St Helen's, lost the psalm, kept the comedy at the Fields', and made one mark after dark.
title: One turning of the glass, and dinner at the Fields'
